steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Watch out! Steam pillar.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: So this is your brilliant plan? To have us all die here?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Sorry... I'll be more careful.
The test tube that Isidro throws bursts in mid-air, creating a golden mist.
The mist is soon dispersed by a faintly red jet of air.
Followed by a powerful burst of steam.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: This will let us predict the steam bursts.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: But I don't have too many left. We'll need to hurry.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Wreckage ahead, Javier. Watch out.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I could blow it up.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: No need. I know what you can do, chaval.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Okay... this ship looks like it's been here for a while.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: It's the first salt ship Juana ever built. She thought it could take us through Skeletal Reef and back to the sea.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: She failed.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: And lost almost everything.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: You see any trace of the boss?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Yes. Not far now.
The ship continues sailing, past a row of towering bone spikes. The cracks running through the surface are filled with blood.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Saltfin blood. Don't let it get to you.
Isidro picks up a piece of salt that rolled down from the cliffs and throws it out.
He opens his palm, and finds it sticky with the blood from the salt.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: There's blood everywhere. What kind of fight happened here?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Is the boss even alive?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: We'll find out soon.
Past the bone pillars, a massive saltfin lies lifeless on the ground, its skull punctured by a helm wheel.
The master of the wheel lays still on its back, blood dripping down her feet.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Señora...

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Juana... no...
They disembark and climb the beast's back. Javier touches the woman's arm. It is still warm, but that fact fills him with even more sorrow.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: I'm sorry. We were too late.
*Cough* *Cough*... Yes, you were.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: S-Señora?!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: And there I was, hoping I wouldn't need to do all the work myself.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Are you okay, boss? You're covered in blood.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: It's not mine. It put up a good fight, but I outlasted it.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: You got anything to drink, Isidro?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Of course.
Juana takes the bottle, climbs down the saltfin's back, and sits down, leaning against it.
She takes a few swigs, and looks at the crowd that had gathered with a smile on her face.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Saltfin garum... What a shame. What I wouldn't do for some fine rum right about now.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Could you lend me a shoulder, Isidro? I have to admit I'm rather spent after all that.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: I'll do it.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Let the boy do it. You folks need to start butchering this saltfin.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: And take that wheel out for me, won't you, Javi?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Sí, señora.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Over here, boy.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: A-Alright.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Now, now, you never rush a lady. Always let her finish her business.
Juana unhurriedly downs the liquid in the bottle, casually tossing the bottlecap into the air and catching it with her other hand. Isidro can only watch and wait.
There is movement in Juana's throat from time to time. She takes her time swallowing.
Or, rather, it takes great effort for her to swallow.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: (Whisper) Why are you hiding your injury?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: (Whisper) Just hold on to me, steady now...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: (Whisper) Argh...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: (Whisper) Listen, joven. I can't get hurt.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: (Whisper) Fleet morale has been shaky enough already... I have to seem invincible.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: (Whisper) You just gave them an entire month's worth of meals.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: (Whisper) They'd take care of you.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: (Whisper) I'm not worried about betrayal, but... if I go down, they'll think the situation is dire, and that's when they start panicking.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: (Whisper) So, keep me steady... I don't want to fall on my face in front of everyone.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: (Whisper) Argh...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: (Whisper) Your ribs are cracked. I can't hold you too hard.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: (Whisper) It's alright... I can take it.

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: Señor Calificador, there is a salt ship approaching from the southwest.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Hand me your scope.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Seems like they've had quite the catch. Just look at that thing they're dragging behind...

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Would you like to see for yourself?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: ...I'll give the order to attack.
Silver raises the spyglass. Through the round lens, he sees a skull flag flapping in the wind.
In all his years on the Salt Flat, he had never looked forward to it so much.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: How is it?

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Enough for everyone, and then some.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Good. Then we'll have plenty of materials to repair the compass.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: ...I guess.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Señora... I...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Leave the rest to me. You're tired; you need rest.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: ...I suppose you're right. I know I can count on you.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Need any help getting back to your quarters?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Just do your job. I'm exhausted, not crippled.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: ...Aye aye.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Got a question, chaval.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Yeah?

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Is the boss hurt?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Why would you think that? There's nothing wrong with her.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Don't lie to me. Liars get lashes in this crew, you know.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Are you worried?

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Of course I am. She never shows weakness in front of the others. I hardly ever see her get injured... but for some reason she keeps getting new scars.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: If she's hurt, I don't want her to hide it from us.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: ...She'll be fine.

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: Target in range!

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Fire at will.

steps.name: Scream From Outside
steps.text: Argh—!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: What was that?!

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: It's the Inquisition!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Where's my wheel?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: They came for our quarry.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: But you're... I'll go! Just wait inside!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: And watch as the Inquisition takes what's mine? Never.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Juana!

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Juana!!

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Promise me you'll—

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Look out!

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: What the—

steps.name: Distracted Sailor
steps.text: Argh—!

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Ambush! Take cover!

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Mierda, it's the Inquisition!

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Wish I knew. Someone must've leaked our hunting route.

steps.name: Panicked Sailor
steps.text: Teach! Those finshits came for our catch!

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Tell me something I don't know! What about the guards?

steps.name: Panicked Sailor
steps.text: They were caught by surprised. We've got casualties.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Tell them to pull back!

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: What about the saltfin?

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Is that meat more important than our lives?

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Full speed ahead! Shake them!

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I'm not part of your crew, though. I'll check on the saltfin.

steps.name: Hapless Sailor
steps.text: Argh—

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: The guards around the saltfin have been neutralized. We cut the rope. They can't pull the meat with them.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: And the remaining pirates?

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: Hiding inside the ship.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: A shame... We could have taken the ship too if we had more men.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: What of the Alguacil?

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: Went to pursue the ones who fled.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Tell him to return. We have the saltfin. No need to overextend ourselves.

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: Señor!
A massive helm wheel flies towards Silver. He jumps back in the nick of time and almost falls backwards.
A woman in black leaps down from the salt ship, catching the flying helm wheel in her hand.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Where do you think you're going with my catch, Inquisitor?

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: You... The corrupting Ægir.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Oh, it's you, joven. I thought you might grow up a little when you became calificador, but it seems you're no different from your treacherous predecessor, Silver.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Always looking to stab people in the back.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Did you expect to be treated kindly, sinner?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Was I being too nice? Would you prefer to continue this conversation with the sword?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Did you perhaps think that by killing the arbiter of justice you would become one?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: I was wondering what got you bold enough to venture into the Salt Flat. You found a backer.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: That woman is the leader of the pirates, Señor Alguacil!

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Then you're the mastermind behind the theft of the compass... Tell me, do you cling to it even now?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: And what loathsome desires has it drawn out from you?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: (Damn it, my wounds... I can't dodge!)

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Are you out of your mind? He almost hit you.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: (Whisper) Silence, joven. Do you think I wanted to get hit?

spans.text: (Whisper) Silence, joven. Do you think I

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: We need to get back to the ship. That guy's too strong for us. We can't fight him like this.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Ah, we meet again.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Then you shall receive judgment together.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: We need to go! They came prepared, while we're exhausted!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: If you're not going to help, then stay out of my way!

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Teach just gave the order to sail! You'll be left behind!

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: The ship needs to shake them! We can't wait for you!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: You go back.
Juana tries to stand, but cannot find the strength.
The Alguacil and warrior priests approach. In the distance, Silver stands atop her catch with a smug expression.
Enough food to feed the fleet for a month. Important materials for repairing the compass.
She cannot afford to lose it, if she is to return to the ocean.
'Señora Juana! Come back!'
Juana hears Javier's voice calling to her from the ship's stern.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Grab Juana, chaval! We're throwing the ladder down!

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Blood... your wounds have opened up!

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: What're you waiting for?! Get up here!
She must not pass out. Her crew needs her. There is a future she must lead her fleet into.
She made a promise to Cruz.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Don't let them get away!

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Señora Juana!

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Juana!

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Señora Juana!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Shut... up...
She can withstand the pain and darkness back no longer. They overcome her.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Juana! You're awake.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Don't worry, we're safe.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Argh... where's Teach?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: She's busy elsewhere. I'm here by your side.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: What about the boy... Where did he go? Did he run away...?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: No, he brought you back.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Do you want to see him? I can go get him.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: What is he doing?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: ...He's with Teach, treating the crew members who were injured in the attack.

steps.name: Pained Sailor
steps.text: Aaaahhh— argh—!

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I'm sorry, this ointment hurts when it's applied, but the bleeding should stop soon.

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Now shut up and stop whining!

steps.name: Pained Sailor
steps.text: Go on... argh... I can... take it...

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: How's it going on your end?

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: (Shakes head) Not much we can do...

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Bury the dead in the salts as soon as we can.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Aye... Come with me, chaval. Cesc wants to see you.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Is he hurt?

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Got shot in the liver. He's on his last legs... said he wanted to see you.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: ...Take me to him.
Isidro makes his way through the wounded, a bowl of hot soup in hand.
Amongst the many pale faces, he sees a familiar one, smiling at him with what little strength it has left.
He sits beside the wounded man and smiles back.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: You're damn ugly when you smile... you know that?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Sounds like you're in good spirits.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Here, I brought you some soup. You'll feel better.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: No... don't waste it.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: Thanks for coming to see me... and for saving my hide back then.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: I wanted to ask... why did you save me...?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I've thought I was going to die so many time over my journeys.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: But every time, I was lucky enough to meet someone who cared. I know how it feels to be waiting for death.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: It's not pleasant.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: I... *cough* I never knew a damn thing about you... Tell me more...

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: You got... a home?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: No, I don't.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: A family?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Not any I grew up with. My parents left when I was very young.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: How 'bout you tell him where you learned your bag of tricks?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Sure...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Some different people took pity on me and taught me how to survive. Bits and pieces, here and there.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: There was a teacher who taught me how to use a sword.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: We lived together for a long time. I learned a lot from him.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Must've invested a lot in you.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Yeah. He raised me as his successor.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: Why didn't... you stay... with him...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I couldn't live that way. He made me feel safe.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: What's... wrong with that?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Nothing's worse than feeling safe. It makes you let your guard down. But nowhere is truly safe.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: You know, amigo...

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: You don't have a home... don't like feeling safe, don't want to settle down... living side-by-side with danger...

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: You were... born to be a pirate...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Maybe I was.
Isidro says no more. The soup has long since become cold in the night wind of the Salt Flat.
He raises the bowl and takes a sip. It has been a month, and he is already used to its thick, salty flavor.
